title: I was in a mall! And there was a new kind of food in it!
content: The mall part was after a fairly long sequence involving underground tunnels, some bad guys in the tunnels, being contacted by a gang leader named "Lusitano" who wanted me to destroy the tunnels, yeah did I mention tunnels? That scene flipped to one in which I was driving to a gas station, and my car began malfunctioning in strange ways, but I yelled at it and it miraculously stopped. I filled up with gas and continued on my way. And then I was suddenly in a mall. The first store I went to was a food warehouse type, with a lot of different new foods in it. One was a cookie similar to a fortune cookie, but they came in several different flavors including red chili, vanilla white, black "mystery flavor" etc. Another was a fruit popsicle of some kind that could get you drunk. There were stacks and stacks of boxes. Very tall ceilings. I wanted to look more, especially because I thought I saw some crab rangoons and I'm craving them so badly, but the store owner chased me out. "Hey I know you!! Not today! Get out!" I then went to a jewelry store where most of the items were huge, beaded necklaces. Like strings on strings of colored beads. It was nice but not that notable and I left. There was a movie theater in the mall but I didn't go in. I know I have been to a very similar theater in dreams before and I watched a Saw movie there. It was on the second floor with a bunch of restaurants. Finally I ended up in a Sephora, and they were having a deal. "$20 off gasoline purchases with $100 purchase of makeup, our partnership with Marie Kondo" I didn't question this at all, and began looking for stuff to buy. This store had makeup in pretty much every possible skin tone and several types of masks, creams, powders. If you could think of makeup it was probably there. And expensive. Some items cost $140 for a single thing. I picked up a skin cream that promised "perfect skin until you're 80, with just one use" and went to buy it. (Again...didn't question this.) The store was quite crowded, and people were GLARING at me the entire time. Before I could check out, they all started ganging up to run me out of the store. And that was the end of the dream.
